disposition_reason: Original model-brain RSA is ordered, but the exact paper model/layer/ROI result vectors and historical native settings are not recovered. Descriptive temporal-model family differences and figure assembly are not themselves improvable performance endpoints. A prospective candidate must be compared against the original full reference catalog, not an arbitrary local model or selected ROI.

source_paper.title: One Hundred Neural Networks and Brains Watching Videos: Lessons from Alignment

evidence.supports: Original RSA definition,99 model conditions,10 participants,102 repeated test videos; PCA and training-video branches differ.

evidence.locator: main: feature extraction; RDMCreator; RSA; pvalue and layer-order logic
evidence.supports: Released script uses PCA100 with102 estimator rows, raw RSA outputs and multiplicity-sensitive layer selection.
versionB/MNI152/merged_hemispheres_streams_pkl; test selection; subject data not externally averaged.

evidence.locator: Published scope; Operation compiler and its limits; Catalog and independent branch bindings
evidence.supports: Historical branch consumers are nonexecuting and do not authenticate historical scores;92-model Fig16 and51-model Fig17 branches are not99-model completion.

target.description: Measure out-of-the-box model-layer representational alignment to each BOLDMoments ROI, using correlation of model and brain dissimilarities; retain all original catalog comparisons.

dataset.description: BOLDMoments source derivatives versionB in MNI152, merged hemispheres/streams, are specified; immutable source-to-OpenNeuro derivative and stimulus manifest matching the historical run remain unauthenticated.

cohort.description: 10 human participants; paper compares99 model conditions. The original test analysis uses102 video stimuli, each presented10 times.

split.description: Original RSA uses102 repeated test videos. The1000-video training set is a separate Fig17 analysis and cannot replace it or be renamed a hidden test.

inputs.description: Original video inputs and pretrained model features plus ROI brain responses; no fitted voxel-wise readout or brain-target reweighting in the original emergent-alignment task.

preprocessing.description: Paper averages brain repetitions; reduces model features with PCA100 without standardization. Released script specifies102 estimator rows. Match exact video subclip aggregation, checkpoint versions, PCA settings and dependency version before historical parity.

metric.description: RDM entries are1-Pearson correlation; layer/ROI alignment is Spearman correlation between the upper-triangle model and subject RDM vectors.

aggregation.description: Mean layer RSA across subjects; original whole-model score for each ROI is the maximum across model layers, not a mean across arbitrarily selected ROIs.

comparison.primary_metric: Original per-ROI subject-mean RSA with the paper layer rule; full catalog and ROI profile retained

published_baseline.description: Paper provides per-model/ROI figures; no exact authenticated numerical reference vector or justified scalar across ROIs is recovered. Do not digitize a convenient bar as an exact benchmark.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No model feature extraction or RSA rerun performed. Author calc_alignment.py is a route, not measured reproduction.

minimum_effect.rationale: Meaningful alignment gain must be defined after source scores and noise ceilings are recovered; no universal rho margin or chosen-ROI exception is imposed.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare a paired participant-based procedure accounting for ROI/model/layer selection and stimulus dependence; published significance against zero does not test superiority over the strongest paper reference.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Human participants, with shared stimuli and correlated ROIs/model layers; RDM pair entries are not independent samples.
uncertainty.rationale: No confirmatory rule has been admitted. Repeated calculations on the same biological observations do not create independent samples.

paper_win_requires: Recover original per-participant/layer/ROI reference scores and full99-condition membership; distinguish92-model Fig16 and51-model Fig17 comparisons explicitly.
Preserve original102 videos, preprocessing, pretrained exposure and per-ROI layer-max metric. A new stimulus split or altered brain-response fitting is a separate extension.
Fix any primary across-ROI decision rule before candidate feedback and preserve the whole original profile; winning a selected ROI or weak model is insufficient.
Disclose public test exposure and freeze candidate and layer-selection procedure before final evaluation; do not call these public videos an unseen benchmark.
Require meaningful source-relative RSA improvement and valid selection-aware uncertainty; stronger family contrast significance is not a paper win.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison was reviewed or established.

episode.improvement_loop: After baseline recovery, develop candidate representations using declared permitted videos/feedback with complete source exposure recorded; all original reference model conditions remain visible in reports.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze candidate weights, input sampling, model/layer catalog, reduction and aggregation policies before final RSA.
episode.final_evaluation: Run the original102-video protocol on the complete participant/ROI population and compare to authentic source scores; report any1000-video extension separately.
episode.baseline_policy: Original paper figures, rerun author metrics and new candidate results must have distinct provenance. Budgets and evaluator qualification remain required before activation.

blocking_issues: Exact original reference vectors and complete checkpoint/dependency manifests absent.
Historical SRP/no-reduction and training-set configurations are not equivalent to hardcoded current PCA script.
Public102-video exposure and layer-max selection require an explicit inference/access policy.
Current source bridge and branch consumers do not execute or qualify scientific feature extraction/RSA.
No fixed access/resource budget, effect size or superiority uncertainty rule.

legacy.notes: Keep registered-runtime and dimension-branches as calibration/source-contract components. Their completeness checks and figure reproduction cannot satisfy scientific improvement.
